component.name: NoirADB
component.summary: Universal Android debloater over ADB, without root

description.p: NoirADB removes bloatware, ads and telemetry from Android phones of any brand (Xiaomi, Samsung, Google Pixel, OnePlus, OPPO, realme, vivo, Motorola, Huawei and more). It works over ADB and needs no root and no bootloader unlock.

ul.li: Multi-brand package lists with plain-Spanish descriptions and a risk rating
The package lists update from the project repository without reinstalling the app
Reversible: apps are uninstalled for the current user only and can be restored

description.p: NoirADB is inspired by the original Xiaomi Debloater project by Fadel Trivandi Dipantara, evolved into a universal debloater with a Spanish interface and the Flat Noir visual identity.
